alternatives.transcript: Maria takes the bus to work every morning. Today, it is raining, so she brings her blue umbrella. At her stop, she runs to the office and forgets it on the seat. In the afternoon, the driver finds the umbrella and keeps it safe. The next day, he smiles and gives it back to her.
